# Certificate fixtures

Populated by M1 per technical specification Section 22. All fixtures are
generated by `generate_fixtures.py` (run `python tests/fixtures/certs/generate_fixtures.py`
to regenerate) and checked into the repo as static files so tests are fast
and reproducible — nothing here is regenerated at test-collection time.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `root_public.pem`, `intermediate_public.pem` | Stand-in "public" CA lineage. Tests pass `root_public.pem` explicitly as `trust_roots` to simulate certifi's trust bundle, so tests never depend on real, live public CAs |
| `leaf_valid_public_ca.pem` | Category 2: valid chain to the (test-)public root |
| `leaf_expired.pem` | Same lineage, expired |
| `leaf_self_signed.pem` | Category 1: genuinely self-signed leaf |
| `root_private.pem`, `intermediate_private.pem`, `leaf_private_ca.pem` | Category 3: correctly-built private/internal CA chain — `root_private.pem` is never in `trust_roots` |
| `leaf_broken_chain.pem` | Category 4: signed by an intermediate that is never presented/available anywhere |
| `root_alt_untrusted.pem`, `intermediate_cross_by_public.pem`, `intermediate_cross_by_alt.pem`, `leaf_cross_signed.pem` | Cross-signed intermediate: same key, two issuing certs, only one (`root_public`) trusted — tests that path building finds the valid path through the noise |
| `leaf_wrong_host.pem` | Valid chain, SAN doesn't match the hostname under test (category 5, orthogonal) |
| `leaf_wildcard.pem` | SAN `*.example.com` — matches `foo.example.com`, must NOT match `foo.bar.example.com` |
| `leaf_ip_san.pem` | SAN contains an IP address entry (`10.0.0.5`) |
| `leaf_weak_key.pem` | RSA-1024 (the floor this `cryptography` build allows — still below the 2048-bit modern minimum) |
| `leaf_sha1_signed.pem` | Signature-algorithm field relabeled to `sha1WithRSAEncryption` after signing (this `cryptography`/OpenSSL build refuses to actually sign with SHA1) — exercises field extraction only, not a cryptographically real SHA1 signature |
| `leaf_adversarial_cn.pem` | Subject CN containing injection-style text (`<script>alert(1)</script>`) — must be stored/displayed as an inert string, never interpreted |
| `malformed_not_pem.txt`, `malformed_truncated.der` | Not valid PEM/DER at all — must raise `CertificateParseError`, never crash silently or unhandled |
